description: The machine-checkable half of docs/__meta__/arch-adr.md#2-frontmatter and docs/__meta__/arch-adr.md#3-sections. Context, Decision and Consequences in that order, with any other section before, between or after them. No section has a word cap and the file has no token budget.

name.description: adr-<NNN>-<subject>: the document number docs/__meta__/arch.md allocates, one sequence shared by every document in docs/arch/, then the subject in a few kebab-case words. See docs/__meta__/arch-adr.md#1-naming.

status.description: accepted once the owner settles it; frozen once rejected, superseded or deprecated.

outline.description: The situation and the forces that call for a decision.
examples:
The checks package already has the right foundation. A `Database` wraps one revision and memoizes every derived
value as a query. A check is a pure function of the values those queries return. The engine keeps all of that.

outline.description: What is decided, as statements a reader can hold the result to.
examples:
1. **One registry**, discovered by a package walk, is the only list of rules. The runner, the rulebook and the
   tests read it.

outline.description: What follows from the decision: what changes, what it costs, and what stays true.
examples: - **More files, each smaller.** About 45 rule modules replace today's check modules.
